name: Erica
source:
A solitary and cool princess knight who is hailed as the strongest.
She fights to reclaim her homeland, which was stolen from her by Carla, the queen of an invading nation.
Although she is seen as cold and unfriendly, her feelings for her country and people are passionate, and people love her.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1264144
